source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M4进行时场面描写）

lines.en: Mum: Who can help me? I can't carry everything.
lines.zh: 妈妈：谁来帮我？我一个人拿不动这么多。

lines.en: Simon: Sorry, I can't.
lines.zh: 西蒙：抱歉，我帮不了。

lines.en: Mum: My books are falling. Look at the mess! The cola is falling too, and the eggs are broken. What a mess! Who can help me?
lines.zh: 妈妈：我的书在往下掉。看这乱糟糟的！可乐也洒了，鸡蛋碎了。真乱！谁来帮帮我？

lines.en: Simon: Let me help you. I'll pick up the books.
lines.zh: 西蒙：我来帮你。我把书捡起来。

lines.en: Mum: Thank you, Simon. Now the room looks tidy again.
lines.zh: 妈妈：谢谢你，西蒙。现在房间又整齐了。

title: He is playing the suona, but the phone rings.（进行时+but·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M5进行时+but突发）

lines.en: Daming: Today is my birthday. I will play the suona for you.
lines.zh: 大明：今天是我生日，我给大家吹唢呐。

lines.en: Daming is playing the suona, but the phone rings.
lines.zh: 大明正吹着唢呐，电话响了。

lines.en: Daming: Hello? …OK, Mum. I'll be right there. Sorry, where was I? Let me play again.
lines.zh: 大明：喂？……好的妈妈，我马上来。对不起，我吹到哪儿了？再吹一遍。

lines.en: Daming is playing the suona again, but the bell rings at the door.
lines.zh: 大明又吹起唢呐，门铃响了。

lines.en: Lingling: That must be Auntie Wang!
lines.zh: 玲玲：一定是王阿姨！

lines.en: Daming is playing the suona for the third time, but the dog starts to bark.
lines.zh: 大明第三次吹唢呐，狗开始叫。

lines.en: Sam: Your dog loves the suona!
lines.zh: 萨姆：你的狗也喜欢唢呐！

lines.en: Daming: Actually, he is afraid of the loud sound. We still had a lovely party.
lines.zh: 大明：其实它是被响声吓到了。尽管这样，我们的派对还是很开心。

title: He's riding his bike, but it starts to rain.（进行时+but·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M5进行时+but并列）

lines.en: He's riding his bike, but it starts to rain. She's doing exercise, but it gets too hot. He's walking in the park, but it starts to snow. She's watching TV, but the bell rings. They are having a picnic, but it starts to rain. When an interruption comes, we stop and deal with it, then carry on and finish what we enjoy.
lines.zh: 他正骑着自行车，可天开始下雨。她正在锻炼，可天气变得太热。他正在公园散步，可开始下雪。她正在看电视，门铃响了。他们正在野餐，可开始下雨。当打断来临时，我们先停下处理，再接着完成喜欢做的事。

title: It was Daming's birthday yesterday.（一般过去时·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M6一般过去时/生日礼物）

lines.en: It was Daming's birthday yesterday. Simon's mum bought him a present. It was a book about space travel. Daming was very interested in the book. It was a red pen on Sam's birthday, and Lingling bought it for him. The family had a happy dinner together. Daming thanked everyone for the nice presents.
lines.zh: 昨天是大明的生日。西蒙的妈妈给他买了一份礼物，是一本关于太空旅行的书。大明对这本书很感兴趣。萨姆生日时，玲玲送他一支红笔。一家人开心地吃了晚饭，大明感谢大家送的好礼物。

title: The name of the spaceship is Shenzhou V.（航天·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M6 Shenzhou V话题）

lines.en: Daming and Simon made a model of a Chinese spaceship. The name of the spaceship is Shenzhou V. In 2003, it took a Chinese taikonaut into space for the first time. It took the national flag of China and some seeds too. Daming put the model on his desk and dreamed of space. Work hard, and the dream may come true.
lines.zh: 大明和西蒙做了一个中国宇宙飞船模型，飞船名叫神舟五号。2003年，它第一次把中国航天员送入太空，还带上了中国国旗和一些种子。大明把模型放在书桌上，梦想着太空。努力学习，梦想也许会实现。

title: He spent about twenty-one hours in space.（名人·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M7 Yang Liwei话题）

lines.en: In October 2003, my father flew into space in Shenzhou V. He spent about twenty-one hours in space. He did a lot of work there. He also made a video in space. Then he came back to the earth safely. He was nervous, but he trained for many years. His story tells us that hard work and courage can take us far.
lines.zh: 2003年10月，我的父亲乘坐神舟五号进入太空。他在太空度过了大约二十一个小时，在那里做了大量工作，还拍了一段太空视频，然后安全返回地球。他很紧张，但训练了很多年。他的故事告诉我们，努力与勇气能带我们走得很远。

title: She couldn't see or hear.（Helen Keller·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M7 Helen Keller话题）

lines.en: Helen Keller was born in the US in 1880. As a baby, she became blind and deaf. She couldn't see or hear. Then a teacher named Anne Sullivan came to her. She spelled words into Helen's hand, one letter at a time. At last Helen understood that every thing had a name. Later she went to college and became a famous writer. She gave hope to people around the world.
lines.zh: 海伦·凯勒1880年生于美国。婴儿时期她又盲又聋，看不见也听不见。后来一位叫安妮·沙莉文的老师来到她身边，一个字母一个字母地在她手上拼单词。海伦终于明白，每样东西都有名字。后来她上了大学，成为著名作家，给世界各地的人带来希望。

title: Why do you have cups on your heads?（because·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M8 Why/ because问答）

lines.en: Teacher: Wait a minute. Why do you have cups on your heads?
lines.zh: 老师：等一下。你们为什么把杯子扣在头上？

lines.en: Daming: It's a long story, Miss Wang.
lines.zh: 大明：说来话长，王老师。

lines.en: Teacher: Why are you wearing a hat, Lingling? It's not hot.
lines.zh: 老师：玲玲，你为什么戴帽子？又不热。

lines.en: Lingling: Um… it's a secret.
lines.zh: 玲玲：嗯……这是个秘密。

lines.en: Teacher: Sam, why is your face covered in flour?
lines.zh: 老师：萨姆，你脸上为什么全是面粉？

lines.en: Sam: We planned to make a surprise cake for you. But the cake fell, so we used the cups to catch the cream.
lines.zh: 萨姆：我们想给您做个惊喜蛋糕，可蛋糕塌了，就用杯子接奶油。

lines.en: Teacher: You are the naughtiest class, but also the sweetest. Let's clean up together.
lines.zh: 老师：你们是最淘气的班，也是最贴心的班。我们一起收拾吧。

title: Why are you wearing a hat?（because·服饰·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M8 Why/because句型）

lines.en: —Why are you wearing a raincoat?
lines.zh: ——你为什么穿雨衣？

lines.en: —Because it's going to rain.
lines.zh: ——因为要下雨了。

lines.en: —Why are you wearing a hat?
lines.zh: ——你为什么戴帽子？

lines.en: —Because it's going to be sunny.
lines.zh: ——因为天要放晴。

lines.en: —Why are you wearing a T-shirt?
lines.zh: ——你为什么穿T恤？

lines.en: —Because I'm going to play basketball.
lines.zh: ——因为我要去打篮球。

lines.en: —Why are you wearing a dress?
lines.zh: ——你为什么穿连衣裙？

lines.en: —Because I'm going to the theatre.
lines.zh: ——因为我要去剧院。

lines.en: We choose clothes for the weather and the plan of the day.
lines.zh: 我们根据天气和当天计划选择衣服。

title: Best wishes to you!（毕业祝福·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M9 Best wishes话题）

lines.en: Dear friends, we're going to say goodbye to our primary school soon. I enjoyed our time together. I want to remember you all. Please write a message in this book. I'll keep it forever.
lines.zh: 亲爱的朋友们，我们很快就要告别小学了。我很喜欢和大家在一起的时光，想永远记住你们。请在这本本子上留言，我会一直珍藏。

lines.en: To Amy: Wishing you happiness every day.
lines.zh: 给艾米：祝你幸福每一天。

lines.en: To Sam: Good luck in your new middle school.
lines.zh: 给萨姆：祝你在新中学好运。

lines.en: To our teacher: Thank you for helping us.
lines.zh: 给老师：谢谢您帮助我们。

lines.en: Best wishes to you, my dear friends. We may meet again on holidays.
lines.zh: 向你致以最美好的祝愿，我亲爱的朋友。我们假期还会再见。

title: Wishing you happiness every day.（告别信·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M9告别信写作）

lines.en: Dad: What are you doing, Lingling?
lines.zh: 爸爸：玲玲，你在做什么？

lines.en: Lingling: I'm writing goodbye letters to all my friends at school.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我在给学校所有朋友写告别信。

lines.en: Dad: That's a good idea. What are you writing in your letters?
lines.zh: 爸爸：好主意。信里写什么？

lines.en: Lingling: First I write the name of a friend. Then I write "Wishing you happiness every day" in every letter.
lines.zh: 玲玲：先写朋友的名字，然后每封信都写上“祝你幸福每一天”。

lines.en: Dad: There are about forty letters here. What a lot of good wishes!
lines.zh: 爸爸：这里大约有四十封信，好多美好的祝愿！

lines.en: Lingling: I'll keep all the photos and remember our happy days.
lines.zh: 玲玲：我会保存所有照片，记住我们快乐的日子。

title: We're going to different schools.（升学·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M10 We're going to different schools）

lines.en: Daming: The summer holiday is coming. We're going to different schools.
lines.zh: 大明：暑假就要到了，我们要去不同的学校。

lines.en: Lingling: Yes. I will go to No.1 Middle School near the park.
lines.zh: 玲玲：是啊，我要去公园附近的第一中学。

lines.en: Daming: I will go to Red Star Middle School. It is far away.
lines.zh: 大明：我要去红星中学，它很远。

lines.en: Amy: I am going back to the UK with my parents.
lines.zh: 艾米：我要和父母回英国。

lines.en: Lingling: Are we going to see each other again?
lines.zh: 玲玲：我们还会再见面吗？

lines.en: Amy: Of course. We can write emails every week.
lines.zh: 艾米：当然，我们可以每周写邮件。

lines.en: Daming: New schools mean new friends. Goodbye, everyone. Good luck in the future!
lines.zh: 大明：新学校意味着新朋友。再见，大家，未来好运！

title: What are you going to study?（学科计划·复核整理）
source: 外研版（新标准·三起）；六下联网复核整理（非教材原文，M10 What are you going to study）

lines.en: —What are you going to study at middle school?
lines.zh: ——中学你打算学什么？

lines.en: —Lingling: I am going to study Chinese, Maths and Physics.
lines.zh: ——玲玲：我打算学语文、数学和物理。

lines.en: —Daming: I am going to study Computer Science. I love computers.
lines.zh: ——大明：我打算学计算机科学，我喜欢电脑。

lines.en: —Sam: I am going to play football in the school team.
lines.zh: ——萨姆：我打算加入校足球队。

lines.en: —Amy: In England, I will study History, Science and a new language.
lines.zh: ——艾米：在英国，我将学历史、科学和一门新语言。

lines.en: —We will be busy, but we can still meet and keep in touch.
lines.zh: ——我们会很忙，但仍然可以见面、保持联系。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: I am going to wear my new uniform on the first day of junior high.
lines.zh: 上初中的第一天我打算穿新校服。

lines.en: We are going to have many new subjects this term.
lines.zh: 这学期我们将有许多新科目。

lines.en: What school things do we need to pack?
lines.zh: 我们需要打包哪些学习用品？

lines.en: Welcome to junior high!
lines.zh: 欢迎来到初级中学！

lines.en: Let me show you around our teaching building.
lines.zh: 让我带你参观我们的教学楼。

lines.en: The lab is big, but the library is small.
lines.zh: 实验室很大，但是图书馆很小。

lines.en: Good morning, everyone!
lines.zh: 大家早上好！

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: What's your name?
lines.zh: 你叫什么名字？

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the music room?
lines.zh: 请问，音乐教室在哪里？

lines.en: I often read books in the library after class.
lines.zh: 我课后经常在图书馆看书。

lines.en: This is my classmate, Li Ming.
lines.zh: 这是我的同班同学李明。

lines.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Zhu Xiaomeng.
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。我是朱小萌。

lines.en: I feel a little nervous on my first day.
lines.zh: 第一天我感到有点紧张。

lines.en: I will bring some snacks and balloons to the party.
lines.zh: 我会带一些零食和气球来派对。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: We are going to organise a welcome party for new students.
lines.zh: 我们打算为新生组织一场欢迎派对。

lines.en: Nice to meet you.
lines.zh: 很高兴认识你。

lines.en: Where are you from?
lines.zh: 你来自哪里？

lines.en: Can you help me pack my schoolbag?
lines.zh: 你能帮我收拾书包吗？

lines.en: My favourite subject is geography.
lines.zh: 我最喜欢的科目是地理。

lines.en: The bell is ringing. Let's go into the classroom.
lines.zh: 铃响了。我们进教室吧。

lines.en: How old are you?
lines.zh: 你多大了？

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: My first lesson at junior high was English.
lines.zh: 我在初中的第一节课是英语。

lines.en: It is important to think and learn in class.
lines.zh: 在课堂上思考和学习很重要。

lines.en: In junior high, we have many new subjects to learn.
lines.zh: 在初中，我们有许多新科目要学。

lines.en: I plan to join the sports club to make new friends.
lines.zh: 我计划加入体育俱乐部来结交新朋友。

lines.en: Don't be nervous. Everyone is friendly here.
lines.zh: 别紧张。这里每个人都很友好。

lines.en: My name is Li Ming.
lines.zh: 我的名字叫李明。

lines.en: It's a new start in junior high.
lines.zh: 这是初中的新开始。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: This is my diary about the first day of junior high.
lines.zh: 这是我关于初中第一天的日记。

lines.en: Please circle the correct answers on your paper.
lines.zh: 请在试卷上圈出正确答案。

lines.en: Can you say that again, sir?
lines.zh: 老师，您能再说一遍吗？

lines.en: I forget to bring my eraser today.
lines.zh: 我今天忘记带橡皮了。

lines.en: Our classroom is on the second floor.
lines.zh: 我们的教室在二楼。

lines.en: We should remember the new grammar rules.
lines.zh: 我们应该记住新的语法规则。

lines.en: What problems do you have in your new school?
lines.zh: 你在新学校有什么问题？

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: I think history is really interesting.
lines.zh: 我觉得历史真的很有趣。

lines.en: Let's welcome our new classmate, everyone.
lines.zh: 同学们，让我们欢迎新同学。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: What did you do last weekend?
lines.zh: 你上周末做什么了？

lines.en: The town wasn't so big when I lived here.
lines.zh: 我住在这儿的时候，这个小镇还没有这么大。

lines.en: It was an exciting experience.
lines.zh: 那是一次令人兴奋的经历。

lines.en: We had a magical time at the party yesterday.
lines.zh: 我们昨天在聚会上度过了神奇的时光。

lines.en: How did you learn about the survey?
lines.zh: 你是怎么知道这项调查的？

lines.en: I was born in a small town near the factory.
lines.zh: 我出生在工厂附近的一个小镇上。

lines.en: We went to the museum and saw an exciting show.
lines.zh: 我们去了博物馆，看了一场精彩的演出。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: They were born in the same year.
lines.zh: 他们是同一年出生的。

lines.en: The girl began to cry when she heard the voice.
lines.zh: 女孩听到那个声音时哭了起来。

lines.en: She believed the old man's story about the princess.
lines.zh: 她相信了那位老人讲的关于公主的故事。

lines.en: The old man fell down and hurt his shoulder.
lines.zh: 老人摔倒了，伤到了肩膀。

lines.en: Finally, the barber cut the girl's hair with scissors.
lines.zh: 最后，理发师用剪刀给女孩剪了头发。

lines.en: She received a beautiful basket on her birthday.
lines.zh: 她生日那天收到了一个漂亮的篮子。

lines.en: I lived in that small town ten years ago.
lines.zh: 十年前我住在那个小镇上。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The customer was surprised to see the smart wig.
lines.zh: 那位顾客看到那顶漂亮的假发很惊讶。

lines.en: We had cabbage and beef for dinner last night.
lines.zh: 我们昨晚晚餐吃了卷心菜和牛肉。

lines.en: The room was empty when we arrived.
lines.zh: 我们到达时房间是空的。

lines.en: The accident happened on a cold winter morning.
lines.zh: 事故发生在一个寒冷的冬日早晨。

lines.en: My mother went to the market and bought a basket.
lines.zh: 我妈妈去市场买了一个篮子。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: I believe that he is a kind person.
lines.zh: 我相信他是个善良的人。

lines.en: Although it rained, we still had a good time.
lines.zh: 虽然下雨了，我们仍然玩得很开心。

lines.en: There is a big difference between the two pictures.
lines.zh: 这两张图片之间有很大差别。

lines.en: It's impossible for him to finish the work in one day.
lines.zh: 他一天之内完成这项工作是不可能的。

lines.en: It's a wise decision to study hard.
lines.zh: 努力学习是个明智的决定。

lines.en: I realised I made a mistake.
lines.zh: 我意识到我犯了个错误。

lines.en: I suppose he is at home now.
lines.zh: 我想他现在在家。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: He is willing to help others.
lines.zh: 他愿意帮助别人。

lines.en: I have no doubt about his ability.
lines.zh: 我毫不怀疑他的能力。

lines.en: True friendship lasts forever.
lines.zh: 真正的友谊地久天长。

lines.en: He reached out his hand to shake mine.
lines.zh: 他伸出手来和我握手。

lines.en: The result didn't satisfy him.
lines.zh: 结果没有让他满意。

lines.en: He worked hard and finally succeeded.
lines.zh: 他努力工作，最终成功了。

lines.en: Though we lost the game, we still learn a lot.
lines.zh: 虽然我们输了比赛，但我们仍然学到了很多。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: What's your height?
lines.zh: 你身高多少？

lines.en: Many athletes dream of participating in the Olympics.
lines.zh: 许多运动员梦想参加奥运会。

lines.en: Sit in the front row, please.
lines.zh: 请坐前排。

lines.en: She secretly hoped to win the prize.
lines.zh: 她暗自希望能获奖。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: She is afraid of dogs.
lines.zh: 她怕狗。

lines.en: My parents allow me to watch TV on weekends.
lines.zh: 我父母允许我周末看电视。

lines.en: I arrived in Beijing yesterday.
lines.zh: 我昨天到达北京。

lines.en: Don't be so selfish.
lines.zh: 别这么自私。

lines.en: Don't shout at me.
lines.zh: 别对我大喊大叫。

lines.en: He doesn't like apples, nor does he like bananas.
lines.zh: 他不喜欢苹果，也不喜欢香蕉。

lines.en: I haven't seen him since last year.
lines.zh: 自从去年起我就没见过他。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: They often argue about small things.
lines.zh: 他们经常为小事争吵。

lines.en: I'm deeply moved by the story.
lines.zh: 我被这个故事深深打动了。

lines.en: Let's divide the cake into four pieces.
lines.zh: 我们把蛋糕分成四块吧。

lines.en: What's the population of your city?
lines.zh: 你们城市的人口是多少？

lines.en: We reached an agreement on this matter.
lines.zh: 我们在这件事上达成了一致。

lines.en: I visited my relatives last weekend.
lines.zh: 上周末我看望了亲戚。

lines.en: Whenever I see him, he is smiling.
lines.zh: 每当我看到他，他都在微笑。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
lines.zh: 明天也许会下雨。

lines.en: Thank you for your suggestion.
lines.zh: 谢谢你的建议。

lines.en: Time passes quickly when you're having fun.
lines.zh: 快乐的时光总是过得很快。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: All my days up high in the air will be kept in my memory.
lines.zh: 我会永远记得那些在空中的日子。

lines.en: Some traditional jobs are disappearing. However, new ones are springing up to meet new needs.
lines.zh: 一些传统的工作正在消失，而新的工作正在涌现出来，以满足新的需求。

lines.en: They may soon be replaced by machines.
lines.zh: 它们可能很快就会被机器取代。

lines.en: Um, sign me up for a space tour, please!
lines.zh: 嗯，请为我报名太空旅行！

lines.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
lines.zh: 你长大后想做什么？

lines.en: Window cleaning is not always considered a good job, but I'll never regret it.
lines.zh: 窗户清洁工作并不总是被认为是一份好工作，但我永远不会后悔。

lines.en: I still remember my first summer as a spiderman.
lines.zh: 我依然记得我成为“蜘蛛人”的第一个夏天。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: I was wet all over. Drops of sweat fell in my eyes.
lines.zh: 我浑身湿透了。汗珠滴进了我的眼睛里。

lines.en: I watched her grow bit by bit.
lines.zh: 我看着她一点一点地成长。

lines.en: The city shines brighter because of us, and the job will make us shine, too.
lines.zh: 城市因为我们更加明亮，而这份工作也会让我们大显身手。

lines.en: The result will be put up on the school website.
lines.zh: 结果将被公布在学校的网站上。

lines.en: Is the animation called Snow White?
lines.zh: 这部动画片是叫《白雪公主》吗？

lines.en: This book is loved by children.
lines.zh: 这本书为孩子们所喜爱。

lines.en: This camera is not made in Japan.
lines.zh: 这部相机不是日本制造的。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: It's more than 2,000 years old.
lines.zh: 它有两千多年的历史了。

lines.en: I'm not sure.
lines.zh: 我不确定。

lines.en: That's a huge wonder.
lines.zh: 那是一个巨大的奇观。

lines.en: Though it is raining, we still want to visit it.
lines.zh: 尽管在下雨，我们还是想去参观。

lines.en: The Grand Canyon was not just big.
lines.zh: 大峡谷不仅仅是大。

lines.en: I looked down to the silver stream.
lines.zh: 我低头看向那条银灰色的小溪。

lines.en: Though it was raining, he went out.
lines.zh: 虽然下雨，但他还是出去了。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: They looked grey and silver.
lines.zh: 它们看起来呈灰银色。

lines.en: There were many rocks on both sides.
lines.zh: 两边有许多岩石。

lines.en: Let's call a wonder discussion.
lines.zh: 咱们把它叫做奇观讨论吧。

lines.en: In my opinion, natural wonders are more interesting.
lines.zh: 在我看来，自然奇观更有趣。

lines.en: The sun rose behind me.
lines.zh: 太阳从我身后升起。

lines.en: Some people think it is the greatest wonder.
lines.zh: 有些人认为它是最伟大的奇观。

lines.en: It is in the east of China.
lines.zh: 它在中国东部。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Thousands of people visit it every year.
lines.zh: 每年成千上万的人参观它。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: My family always go somewhere interesting as soon as the holiday begins.
lines.zh: 假期一开始，我们全家总会去有趣的地方。

lines.en: We have celebrated the festival since the first pioneers arrived.
lines.zh: 自第一批拓荒者到达以来，我们就庆祝这个节日。

lines.en: It's a public holiday.
lines.zh: 这是一个公共假日。

lines.en: We stay there until the holiday ends.
lines.zh: 我们待在那里直到假期结束。

lines.en: My family always go somewhere interesting as soon as the holiday begins.
lines.zh: 假期一开始，我们全家总会去某个有趣的地方。

lines.en: We have one day off.
lines.zh: 我们放假一天。

lines.en: While we are staying with them, we're going to spend a few days.
lines.zh: 我们和他们待在一起期间，打算度过几天。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: People gather to celebrate the festival.
lines.zh: 人们聚在一起庆祝节日。

lines.en: It is a time for rest and enjoyment.
lines.zh: 这是休息和享受的时刻。

lines.en: We usually have a picnic on the holiday.
lines.zh: 我们通常在假日去野餐。

lines.en: The weather is fine during the holiday.
lines.zh: 假期期间天气很好。

lines.en: Children like playing with balloons.
lines.zh: 孩子们喜欢玩气球。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: She trained hard, so she became a great player later.
lines.zh: 她训练刻苦，所以后来成了一名伟大的运动员。

lines.en: There were few doctors, so he had to work very hard on his own.
lines.zh: 医生很少，所以他不得不非常努力地独自工作。

lines.en: She is simply the best player.
lines.zh: 她简直是最棒的运动员。

lines.en: Norman Bethune is one of the most famous heroes.
lines.zh: 诺曼·白求恩是最著名的英雄之一。

lines.en: He invented new medical tools to treat the wounded.
lines.zh: 他发明了新的医疗工具来治疗伤员。

lines.en: He worked for 69 hours without stopping.
lines.zh: 他连续工作了69个小时没有休息。

lines.en: He gave his life to helping others.
lines.zh: 他献身于帮助他人。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: He is a hero in China and around the world.
lines.zh: 他是中国和世界的英雄。

lines.en: He was so tired that he fell asleep immediately.
lines.zh: 他太累了，以至于马上就睡着了。

lines.en: The doctor treated many wounded soldiers.
lines.zh: 这位医生治疗了许多受伤的士兵。

lines.en: He came from Canada to help China.
lines.zh: 他从加拿大来帮助中国。

lines.en: She won a gold medal at the Olympics.
lines.zh: 她在奥运会上赢得了一枚金牌。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: How was your holiday?
lines.zh: 你假期过得怎么样？

lines.en: It's the busiest season in China because of the Spring Festival.
lines.zh: 因为春节，这是中国最繁忙的季节。

lines.en: The pilot succeeded in landing on time.
lines.zh: 飞行员成功地按时着陆了。

lines.en: There's nothing to worry about as long as you work hard.
lines.zh: 只要你努力，就没什么可担心的。

lines.en: We'd better get back to work.
lines.zh: 我们最好回去工作。

lines.en: We're looking forward to the school-leavers' party.
lines.zh: 我们都很期待毕业聚会。

lines.en: We toured the city by bus and by taxi.
lines.zh: 我们乘公共汽车和出租车游览了这座城市。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Can you tell me where the station is?
lines.zh: 你能告诉我车站在哪里吗？

lines.en: He's flying back today, but the flight is late.
lines.zh: 他今天乘飞机回来，但航班延误了。

lines.en: How stupid of me!
lines.zh: 我真傻！

lines.en: I'll have someone to talk to on the long journey.
lines.zh: 长途旅程中我有人可以聊天了。

lines.en: I'm afraid you're sitting in my seat.
lines.zh: 恐怕你坐了我的座位。

lines.en: Take off your jacket and sit down.
lines.zh: 脱下夹克坐下吧。

lines.en: This is Seat 12A, but you should be in Car 9.
lines.zh: 这是12A座，但你应该在9号车厢。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Why is travel so difficult in winter?
lines.zh: 为什么冬天出行这么困难？

lines.en: Bad luck!
lines.zh: 真倒霉！

lines.en: Exactly!
lines.zh: 正是如此！

lines.en: It's a long story.
lines.zh: 说来话长。

lines.en: That sounds great!
lines.zh: 听起来很棒！

lines.en: What a surprise!
lines.zh: 真没想到！

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: There is so much fun in playing the guitar.
lines.zh: 弹吉他有这么多乐趣。

lines.en: His hobby is painting, and he shares his works online.
lines.zh: 他的爱好是画画，他在网上分享自己的作品。

lines.en: There were many students trying to help the bird.
lines.zh: 有许多学生试图帮助那只小鸟。

lines.en: I felt joy when I shared my stories with friends.
lines.zh: 当我和朋友们分享我的故事时，我感到快乐。

lines.en: Would you like to join our basketball club?
lines.zh: 你愿意加入我们的篮球俱乐部吗？

lines.en: Different people have different hobbies.
lines.zh: 不同的人有不同的爱好。

lines.en: I practise playing the piano for an hour every day.
lines.zh: 我每天练习弹钢琴一小时。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The band will give a show on the school stage.
lines.zh: 乐队将在学校舞台上演出。

lines.en: It is fun to learn a new instrument.
lines.zh: 学习一种新乐器很有趣。

lines.en: I nod my head to show that I understand.
lines.zh: 我点头表示我明白了。

lines.en: Suddenly, the sound of the drums hit the hall.
lines.zh: 突然，鼓声响彻大厅。

lines.en: Let me introduce my hobby to you.
lines.zh: 让我给你介绍一下我的爱好。

lines.en: There is a volleyball match on Friday afternoon.
lines.zh: 星期五下午有一场排球赛。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: My family's love and support mean a lot to me.
lines.zh: 家人的爱和支持对我来说意义重大。

lines.en: We enjoyed our time together during the weekend.
lines.zh: 周末我们一起度过了愉快的时光。

lines.en: My family always supports me in my decisions.
lines.zh: 我的家人总是支持我的决定。

lines.en: This is a photo of my parents and me.
lines.zh: 这是我父母和我的一张照片。

lines.en: I love my father, because he is strict but kind.
lines.zh: 我爱我的爸爸，因为他严格但善良。

lines.en: We usually go for a walk along the river after dinner.
lines.zh: 晚饭后我们通常沿着河边散步。

lines.en: My son is good at drawing pictures.
lines.zh: 我儿子擅长画画。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The old man is my uncle, not my father.
lines.zh: 那位老人是我叔叔，不是我爸爸。

lines.en: Tears came to my eyes when I read the touching story.
lines.zh: 读那个感人的故事时，我眼里涌出了泪水。

lines.en: My grandfather seldom watches television at night.
lines.zh: 我爷爷晚上很少看电视。

lines.en: Can you tell me about your family?
lines.zh: 你能跟我说说你的家庭吗？

lines.en: I often help my mother cook meals at home.
lines.zh: 我经常在家帮妈妈做饭。

lines.en: This book is my brother's, not mine.
lines.zh: 这本书是我弟弟的，不是我的。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: We usually eat dumplings on the Spring Festival.
lines.zh: 春节时我们通常吃饺子。

lines.en: There are dragon dances everywhere on that day.
lines.zh: 那天到处都有舞龙表演。

lines.en: What special food do people eat at Mid-Autumn Festival?
lines.zh: 中秋节人们吃什么特别的食物？

lines.en: I think we should not waste food at the dinner table.
lines.zh: 我认为我们不应该在餐桌上浪费食物。

lines.en: They are preparing for the Christmas party.
lines.zh: 他们正在为圣诞派对做准备。

lines.en: People in the north often eat sweet rice balls.
lines.zh: 北方人经常吃甜元宵。

lines.en: This dish smells delicious, and it tastes great too.
lines.zh: 这道菜闻起来很香，尝起来也很棒。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Could you please pass me the knife and fork?
lines.zh: 请你把刀叉递给我好吗？

lines.en: We will have a big reunion dinner on New Year's Eve.
lines.zh: 除夕夜我们将吃一顿团圆大餐。

lines.en: I agree with you. Plastic bags cause pollution.
lines.zh: 我同意你的看法。塑料袋会造成污染。

lines.en: What do you usually do on Teachers' Day?
lines.zh: 教师节你通常做什么？

lines.en: The lanterns are hanging on the wall.
lines.zh: 灯笼挂在墙上。

lines.en: It is fun to spend the holiday with relatives.
lines.zh: 和亲戚一起过节很有趣。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The dolphin is swimming happily in the blue water.
lines.zh: 海豚在蓝色的水里快乐地游着。

lines.en: Dogs are our good friends and they never tell lies.
lines.zh: 狗是我们的好朋友，它们从不说谎。

lines.en: We must protect animals because they are our friends.
lines.zh: 我们必须保护动物，因为它们是我们的朋友。

lines.en: Look! The fox is running through the snow.
lines.zh: 看！那只狐狸正在雪地里跑。

lines.en: Pandas like eating bamboo and they sleep for long hours.
lines.zh: 熊猫喜欢吃竹子，而且睡很长时间。

lines.en: There are many amazing animals in the nature report.
lines.zh: 在自然报道中有许多令人惊奇的动物。

lines.en: The dodo died out long ago on the island.
lines.zh: 渡渡鸟很久以前就在岛上灭绝了。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: We are doing research to help these missing birds.
lines.zh: 我们正在做研究来帮助这些失踪的鸟。

lines.en: Can you recognise the animal in the photo?
lines.zh: 你能认出照片里的动物吗？

lines.en: The little cat is looking at itself in the mirror.
lines.zh: 小猫正对着镜子看自己。

lines.en: What animal do you like best, the dolphin or the wolf?
lines.zh: 你最喜欢哪种动物，海豚还是狼？

lines.en: The children are feeding the ducks in the pond.
lines.zh: 孩子们正在池塘边喂鸭子。

lines.en: It is amazing that the ocean is home to many fish.
lines.zh: 海洋是许多鱼类的家园，真令人惊叹。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Plants are very important because they produce oxygen.
lines.zh: 植物非常重要，因为它们产生氧气。

lines.en: The root of the plant grows down into the soil.
lines.zh: 植物的根向下扎进土壤里。

lines.en: We will grow sunflowers in the school yard this spring.
lines.zh: 今年春天我们将在校园里种向日葵。

lines.en: Tea is a popular drink in China and around the world.
lines.zh: 茶是中国乃至全世界受欢迎的饮品。

lines.en: We should protect forests and stop cutting down trees.
lines.zh: 我们应该保护森林，停止砍伐树木。

lines.en: The sunlight helps plants grow fast and strong.
lines.zh: 阳光帮助植物长得又快又壮。

lines.en: This kind of bamboo grows in the south of China.
lines.zh: 这种竹子生长在中国南方。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: People in Hangzhou are famous for their tea houses.
lines.zh: 杭州人以他们的茶馆而闻名。

lines.en: We will have a plant show in the school workshop.
lines.zh: 我们将在学校车间举办一场植物展。

lines.en: The leaves turn yellow when autumn comes.
lines.zh: 秋天来临时叶子变黄。

lines.en: What do you think we can make from corn?
lines.zh: 你认为我们可以用玉米做什么？

lines.en: The sun rises in the east and shines on the leaves.
lines.zh: 太阳从东方升起，照在叶子上。

lines.en: Plants give us food, medicine and wood.
lines.zh: 植物给我们提供食物、药材和木材。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Did any of you hold your breath under water?
lines.zh: 你们中有谁在水下憋气了吗？

lines.en: Both of the boys like running in the marathon.
lines.zh: 两个男孩都喜欢跑马拉松。

lines.en: You can take either of the two surfboards.
lines.zh: 两个冲浪板你可以任选一个。

lines.en: Neither of the answers is right.
lines.zh: 两个答案都不对。

lines.en: None of us knew the finishing line at first.
lines.zh: 起初我们中没有人知道终点线在哪里。

lines.en: Some of the students are watching the match.
lines.zh: 一些学生正在观看比赛。

lines.en: Would you like some water after running?
lines.zh: 跑完步你想喝点水吗？

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: All of the players tried their best.
lines.zh: 所有运动员都尽了全力。

lines.en: Each of us has a dream to win.
lines.zh: 我们每个人都有一个获胜的梦想。

lines.en: My coach encouraged me to keep trying.
lines.zh: 我的教练鼓励我继续努力。

lines.en: Their team lost the match yesterday.
lines.zh: 他们队昨天输了比赛。

lines.en: Please pay attention to the finishing line.
lines.zh: 请注意终点线。

lines.en: Shall we go to watch the final match together?
lines.zh: 我们一起去看决赛好吗？

lines.en: Thanks to his courage, we won the match.
lines.zh: 多亏了他的勇气，我们赢得了比赛。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The runner crossed the finishing line first.
lines.zh: 赛跑者第一个冲过终点线。

lines.en: I have a stomachache after eating too much.
lines.zh: 我吃太多后胃疼。

lines.en: The surfer held his breath and went under water.
lines.zh: 冲浪者屏住呼吸潜入水下。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: More and more people become interested in Chinese food.
lines.zh: 越来越多的人对中国食物感兴趣。

lines.en: The weather gets warmer in spring.
lines.zh: 春天天气变得更暖和。

lines.en: The milk went bad in hot weather.
lines.zh: 天热时牛奶变质了。

lines.en: The dish looks beautiful on the plate.
lines.zh: 这道菜在盘子里看起来很漂亮。

lines.en: You should keep a balanced diet to remain healthy.
lines.zh: 你应该保持均衡饮食以保持健康。

lines.en: Your idea sounds good.
lines.zh: 你的主意听起来不错。

lines.en: The beef soup tastes delicious.
lines.zh: 这道牛肉汤尝起来很美味。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: I feel tired after cooking for two hours.
lines.zh: 做了两个小时饭我觉得累了。

lines.en: He fell ill and had to take some medicine.
lines.zh: 他病了，得吃点药。

lines.en: The boy grew tall and strong.
lines.zh: 这男孩长得又高又壮。

lines.en: The recipe seems easy to follow.
lines.zh: 这个食谱看起来很容易照着做。

lines.en: The medicine tastes terrible but it works.
lines.zh: 这药味道很难吃，但有效。

lines.en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
lines.zh: 秋天树叶变黄。

lines.en: Add some salt and oil to the pot.
lines.zh: 往锅里加些盐和油。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Cut the beef into thin slices.
lines.zh: 把牛肉切成薄片。

lines.en: There is a hen on the farm.
lines.zh: 农场里有一只母鸡。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping.
lines.zh: 安静！宝宝在睡觉。

lines.en: Don't watch too much TV after school.
lines.zh: 放学后不要看太多电视。

lines.en: Let me help you with the housework.
lines.zh: 让我帮你做家务吧。

lines.en: Let's choose an interesting book to read.
lines.zh: 咱们选一本有趣的书来读吧。

lines.en: Make a list of things you need for the trip.
lines.zh: 把旅行需要的东西列个清单。

lines.en: No photos in the museum.
lines.zh: 博物馆内禁止拍照。

lines.en: Please don't make so much noise.
lines.zh: 请不要这么吵。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Be careful not to hurt your neck.
lines.zh: 小心别伤到脖子。

lines.en: Choose a book that interests you.
lines.zh: 选一本你感兴趣的书。

lines.en: Don't forget to take the key with you.
lines.zh: 别忘了带钥匙。

lines.en: Invite your friends to your party.
lines.zh: 邀请你的朋友参加你的聚会。

lines.en: Set up your tent near the river.
lines.zh: 把帐篷搭在河边。

lines.en: Take exercise every day to keep fit.
lines.zh: 每天锻炼以保持健康。

lines.en: Don't worry about the boring show.
lines.zh: 别为这场无聊的演出担心。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Have a rest when you feel tired.
lines.zh: 累了就休息一下。

lines.en: Take a deep breath and relax.
lines.zh: 深呼吸，放松。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The weather today is better than yesterday.
lines.zh: 今天天气比昨天好。

lines.en: This road is less crowded than that one.
lines.zh: 这条路没有那条路挤。

lines.en: The sky is getting brighter and brighter.
lines.zh: 天空越来越亮。

lines.en: The view is more beautiful than I expected.
lines.zh: 景色比我预想的更美。

lines.en: The plateau is higher than the grassland.
lines.zh: 高原比草原更高。

lines.en: The higher you climb, the farther you see.
lines.zh: 你爬得越高，看得越远。

lines.en: This is the most beautiful place I have ever seen.
lines.zh: 这是我见过最美的地方。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The cliff is the highest of the three.
lines.zh: 这处悬崖是三者中最高的。

lines.en: He doesn't run as fast as his brother.
lines.zh: 他没有他哥哥跑得快。

lines.en: There are fewer snakes here than in the south.
lines.zh: 这儿的蛇比南方少。

lines.en: This room is much bigger than that one.
lines.zh: 这个房间比那个大得多。

lines.en: The plateau is one of the most amazing places in China.
lines.zh: 高原是中国最神奇的地方之一。

lines.en: This tower is the second tallest in the city.
lines.zh: 这座塔是市里第二高的。

lines.en: Which is farther from here, the lake or the river?
lines.zh: 哪个离这儿更远，湖还是河？

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Few people live on the high plateau.
lines.zh: 很少有人住在高海拔高原上。

lines.en: The sea looks calm in the early morning.
lines.zh: 清晨大海看起来很平静。

lines.en: The view from the hill is pretty good.
lines.zh: 从山上看到的景色相当不错。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The lake is as deep as 50 metres.
lines.zh: 这湖深达50米。

lines.en: The waterfall is as high as a hill.
lines.zh: 这瀑布和一座小山一样高。

lines.en: Please reply to me as soon as possible.
lines.zh: 请尽快回复我。

lines.en: I expect to arrive at the airport at noon.
lines.zh: 我预计中午到达机场。

lines.en: I'm looking forward to the trip to the ancient town.
lines.zh: 我期待着去古镇的旅行。

lines.en: The hotel is not as comfortable as I expected.
lines.zh: 这家酒店没有我预想的舒服。

lines.en: We spent two days visiting places of interest.
lines.zh: 我们花了两天时间游览名胜。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: We arrived at the hotel at 8 p.m.
lines.zh: 我们晚上8点到达酒店。

lines.en: She is as busy as a bee.
lines.zh: 她忙得团团转。

lines.en: The local food is different from ours.
lines.zh: 当地食物和我们的不同。

lines.en: We set out early in the morning.
lines.zh: 我们一大早就出发了。

lines.en: We took a lot of photos of the beautiful view.
lines.zh: 我们拍了很多美景的照片。

lines.en: My bag is the same as yours.
lines.zh: 我的包和你的一样。

lines.en: We went to the island by plane.
lines.zh: 我们乘飞机去了那座岛。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: We had a wonderful time on the trip.
lines.zh: 我们旅途玩得很开心。

lines.en: Take a mask with you to the ancient wall.
lines.zh: 带上口罩去古城墙吧。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: This book costs ten yuan.
lines.zh: 这本书十元钱。

lines.en: I downloaded a new game from the Internet.
lines.zh: 我从网上下载了一个新游戏。

lines.en: The invention of the computer has changed our lives.
lines.zh: 电脑的发明改变了我们的生活。

lines.en: Can you lend me a hand with this box?
lines.zh: 你能帮我抬一下这个箱子吗？

lines.en: There will be a book fair next month.
lines.zh: 下个月将有一场书展。

lines.en: The teacher warned us not to be late.
lines.zh: 老师警告我们不要迟到。

lines.en: We should apply what we've learned to practice.
lines.zh: 我们应该把所学知识应用到实践中。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Despite the rain, we still went out.
lines.zh: 尽管下雨，我们还是出去了。

lines.en: Children have a strong sense of curiosity.
lines.zh: 孩子们有很强的好奇心。

lines.en: She has a talent for music.
lines.zh: 她有音乐天赋。

lines.en: English is widely spoken around the world.
lines.zh: 英语在全世界被广泛使用。

lines.en: Congratulations on your success!
lines.zh: 祝贺你取得成功！

lines.en: We did an experiment in the science class.
lines.zh: 我们在科学课上做了一个实验。

lines.en: What's the function of this button?
lines.zh: 这个按钮有什么功能？

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Failure is the mother of success.
lines.zh: 失败是成功之母。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: The main disadvantage of this car is its high price.
lines.zh: 这辆车的主要缺点是价格高。

lines.en: Everyone is here except Tom.
lines.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都到了。

lines.en: I will love you forever.
lines.zh: 我会永远爱你。

lines.en: It's convenient to live near a supermarket.
lines.zh: 住在超市附近很方便。

lines.en: He has made great progress in English.
lines.zh: 他在英语方面取得了很大进步。

lines.en: Will computers be used more than books in the future?
lines.zh: 将来电脑会比书籍使用得更多吗？

lines.en: They'll be put up on the school website.
lines.zh: 它们将被张贴在学校网站上。

lines.en: Can I borrow your book? I'll return it tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我能借你的书吗？我明天还。

lines.en: Books were only produced one at a time by hand.
lines.zh: 书籍过去只能靠手工一次生产一本。

lines.en: Will books be replaced by the internet?
lines.zh: 书籍会被互联网取代吗？

lines.en: As a result, information spread much faster.
lines.zh: 结果，信息传播得快多了。

lines.en: He looked through the newspaper quickly.
lines.zh: 他快速地浏览了报纸。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: In a way, the internet has changed our reading habits.
lines.zh: 在某种程度上，互联网改变了我们的阅读习惯。

lines.en: The invention of printing changed the world.
lines.zh: 印刷术的发明改变了世界。

lines.en: What's it used for?
lines.zh: 它是用来做什么的？

lines.en: You must use the computer properly.
lines.zh: 你必须正确使用电脑。

lines.en: Thousands of books are stored on the computer.
lines.zh: 成千上万本书被存储在电脑里。

lines.en: Wait and see.
lines.zh: 等着瞧。

lines.en: My memory is full, I need a new memory stick.
lines.zh: 我的内存满了，我需要一个新的内存条。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Can you fix my computer for me?
lines.zh: 你能帮我修电脑吗？

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: I have some photos that I took in Australia last year.
lines.zh: 我有一些去年在澳大利亚拍的照片。

lines.en: Here we go! This is a photo of a sailing boat.
lines.zh: 我们这就看看！这是一张帆船的照片。

lines.en: The Australian cricket team is the best in the world.
lines.zh: 澳大利亚板球队是世界上最好的。

lines.en: The game that they like most is Australian football.
lines.zh: 他们最喜欢的运动是澳式足球。

lines.en: According to the diary, they went to the beach first.
lines.zh: 根据日记记载，他们先去了海滩。

lines.en: At the time, I didn't know the trip would be so great.
lines.zh: 当时我并不知道这次旅行会这么棒。

lines.en: We were surprised at the beautiful view of the beach.
lines.zh: 我们对海滩的美景感到惊讶。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: You can see kangaroos and sheep everywhere.
lines.zh: 你到处都能看到袋鼠和绵羊。

lines.en: They keep sheep on their farm.
lines.zh: 他们在农场上养绵羊。

lines.en: I hate to leave such a beautiful place.
lines.zh: 我真不想离开这么美的地方。

lines.en: The relationship between the two countries is good.
lines.zh: 两国之间的关系很好。

lines.en: We visited some relatives in Perth.
lines.zh: 我们拜访了在珀斯的一些亲戚。

lines.en: The height of the mountain is 500 metres.
lines.zh: 这座山的高度是500米。

lines.en: Riding a horse is a magical experience.
lines.zh: 骑马是一次神奇的经历。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: He's the boy who won the photo competition last year!
lines.zh: 他就是去年赢得摄影比赛的那个男孩！

lines.en: The thing is, my camera is not good enough.
lines.zh: 问题是，我的相机不够好。

lines.en: You're in with a chance of winning!
lines.zh: 你有机会获胜！

lines.en: The person who won the prize for Nature is Li Wei.
lines.zh: 获得自然主题奖的人是李伟。

lines.en: Compared with other years, we received many more photos.
lines.zh: 和其他年份相比，我们收到了多得多的照片。

lines.en: Sunglasses protect your eyes against the strong sun.
lines.zh: 太阳镜保护你的眼睛免受强烈阳光的伤害。

lines.en: I bet you'll be in with a chance!
lines.zh: 我打赌你有机会！

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Even though it was raining, we took great photos.
lines.zh: 尽管下着雨，我们还是拍出了很棒的照片。

lines.en: The headmaster will read out the winners' names tonight.
lines.zh: 校长今晚将宣读获奖者的名字。

lines.en: Congratulations to our winner, Zhao Min!
lines.zh: 祝贺我们的获奖者，赵敏！

lines.en: Don't rush; take your time.
lines.zh: 别急，慢慢来。

lines.en: I have recently taken photos of school life.
lines.zh: 我最近拍了一些校园生活的照片。

lines.en: The general standard of the competition is high.
lines.zh: 比赛的整体水平很高。

lines.en: The photo gives a feeling of peace.
lines.zh: 这张照片给人一种平静的感觉。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: If everyone starts to do something, the world will be saved.
lines.zh: 如果每个人都开始行动，世界就会被拯救。

lines.en: It's no use talking about things we can't do.
lines.zh: 谈论我们做不到的事是没有用的。

lines.en: Though pollution is heavy now, I don't think it's hopeless.
lines.zh: 尽管现在污染很严重，但我认为并非没有希望。

lines.en: Repeat these three words daily: reduce, reuse and recycle.
lines.zh: 每天重复这三个词：减少、再利用、回收。

lines.en: Do you turn off the lights when you leave the room?
lines.zh: 你离开房间时关灯吗？

lines.en: It is better to use china cups and cloth bags because they can be used many times.
lines.zh: 最好使用瓷杯和布袋，因为它们可以多次使用。

lines.en: We divide the waste into things to recycle.
lines.zh: 我们把垃圾分好类以便回收。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Don't throw away bottles that can be recycled.
lines.zh: 不要扔掉可以回收的瓶子。

lines.en: Every day we produce tons of rubbish.
lines.zh: 我们每天产生成吨的垃圾。

lines.en: The factory pours dirty water into the river.
lines.zh: 工厂把脏水排入河里。

lines.en: Air pollution can kill people and animals.
lines.zh: 空气污染会危害人和动物的生命。

lines.en: We should use less plastic in our daily life.
lines.zh: 我们应该在日常生活中少用塑料。

lines.en: We should take steps to reduce pollution.
lines.zh: 我们应该采取措施减少污染。

lines.en: Rubber gloves can be reused many times.
lines.zh: 橡胶手套可以多次使用。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Pollution is the enemy of our health.
lines.zh: 污染是我们健康的敌人。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Did you enjoy yourself in London?
lines.zh: 你在伦敦玩得开心吗？

lines.en: Every student wears school clothes in England.
lines.zh: 在英国每个学生都穿校服。

lines.en: I've been at River School since I was eleven.
lines.zh: 我从11岁起就在河畔学校上学。

lines.en: If I pass my exams next year, I'll stay here until I'm eighteen.
lines.zh: 如果我明年通过考试，我会在这里待到18岁。

lines.en: It's got about 700 pupils, like most schools in England.
lines.zh: 它有约700名学生，像英国大多数学校一样。

lines.en: They don't sit in rows.
lines.zh: 他们不成排坐。

lines.en: What are English schools like?
lines.zh: 英国的学校是什么样的？

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Above all, my friends!
lines.zh: 最重要的是我的朋友们！

lines.en: After-school activities, such as sports clubs and language societies, are popular too.
lines.zh: 课外活动如体育俱乐部和语言社团也很受欢迎。

lines.en: Before class, our teacher checks which pupils are present or absent.
lines.zh: 上课前，老师检查学生出勤情况。

lines.en: Each lesson lasts for an hour.
lines.zh: 每节课持续一小时。

lines.en: Once a term, there is a parents' meeting.
lines.zh: 每学期开一次家长会。

lines.en: Some people learn German instead of French.
lines.zh: 有些人学德语而不是法语。

lines.en: What do I like best about school?
lines.zh: 我最喜欢学校的什么？

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: It's lucky we don't have exams in every subject.
lines.zh: 真幸运我们不是每科都考试。

lines.en: It looks really great.
lines.zh: 它看起来真的很棒。

lines.en: Let's have a look.
lines.zh: 咱们看看吧。

lines.en: That's right.
lines.zh: 没错。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Do you think that life is better today than in the past?
lines.zh: 你认为现在的生活比过去好吗？

lines.en: I think life is better today.
lines.zh: 我认为现在的生活更好。

lines.en: People are wealthier today, and they live longer than they did in the past.
lines.zh: 现在人们更富有，也比过去更长寿。

lines.en: People don't take as much exercise as they used to.
lines.zh: 人们不像过去那样锻炼那么多了。

lines.en: We know more about medicine today, and there's less fear of getting ill.
lines.zh: 我们现在对医学了解更多，对生病的恐惧也少了。

lines.en: We eat better and we live longer.
lines.zh: 我们吃得更好，也更长寿。

lines.en: When the number of cars is doubled, the pollution is also doubled.
lines.zh: 当汽车数量翻倍时，污染也翻倍。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Families have got smaller than they were in the past.
lines.zh: 家庭比过去更小了。

lines.en: Generally speaking, I think life is better today.
lines.zh: 总的来说，我认为现在的生活更好。

lines.en: More wealth sometimes means less health.
lines.zh: 更多的财富有时意味着更少的健康。

lines.en: She's seen how life has changed.
lines.zh: 她见证了生活的变迁。

lines.en: Some people think life in the past was simpler and healthier.
lines.zh: 有些人认为过去的生活更简单、更健康。

lines.en: Transport and travel are easier today.
lines.zh: 现在交通和出行更方便了。

lines.en: Why don't you go and ask Mrs Li, our neighbour?
lines.zh: 你为什么不去问问我们的邻居李太太呢？

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: As a result, there were many illnesses.
lines.zh: 结果是，有很多疾病。

lines.en: Remember to speak up! She's a bit deaf.
lines.zh: 记得大点声说！她有点耳背。

lines.en: That's a good idea.
lines.zh: 好主意。

lines.en: What was your life like in the past?
lines.zh: 你过去的生活是什么样的？

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Before we set off, there are a few rules and suggestions for you.
lines.zh: 出发前，有几条规则和建议要告诉你们。

lines.en: If you see a bear, you mustn't make any sudden moves.
lines.zh: 如果你看到熊，千万不要突然动。

lines.en: We must keep the camp clean.
lines.zh: 我们必须保持营地干净。

lines.en: You mustn't walk too close to the edge of the hill path.
lines.zh: 你们不能太靠近山路的边缘走。

lines.en: You have to keep together so you don't get lost.
lines.zh: 你们必须待在一起，这样才不会迷路。

lines.en: You must be careful of falling stones.
lines.zh: 你们必须当心落石。

lines.en: You mustn't run. No one can run faster than a bear.
lines.zh: 千万不要跑。没人能比熊跑得快。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Bears can climb trees. They can smell food from far away.
lines.zh: 熊会爬树，它们能从很远闻到食物。

lines.en: Don't drink all your water in one go.
lines.zh: 不要一口气把水都喝完。

lines.en: If I reach out, I can just touch him.
lines.zh: 如果我伸出手，就能碰到他。

lines.en: It should be a fairly smooth walk to begin with.
lines.zh: 一开始这段路应该相当平坦。

lines.en: Let's start walking, and we'll stop at noon for our picnic.
lines.zh: 我们开始走吧，中午停下来野餐。

lines.en: People must wake up to the fact that pollution is damaging us.
lines.zh: 人们必须意识到污染正在损害我们。

lines.en: Whenever you go walking in the hills, you should always wear proper clothes.
lines.zh: 无论何时去山里散步，都应穿合适的衣服。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Come on!
lines.zh: 快点！加油！

lines.en: Is that clear?
lines.zh: 清楚了吗？

lines.en: OK, off we go!
lines.zh: 好，我们出发吧！

lines.en: Watch out! Bears about!
lines.zh: 当心！附近有熊！

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: He's had an accident. He fell over when running down the steps.
lines.zh: 他出了意外。他跑下台阶时摔倒了。

lines.en: He's hit his head and his leg hurts.
lines.zh: 他撞到了头，腿也疼。

lines.en: I think he's broken his leg.
lines.zh: 我想他腿骨折了。

lines.en: It's nothing serious.
lines.zh: 没什么严重的。

lines.en: Thanks to better health care, most people are living longer.
lines.zh: 多亏了更好的医疗保健，大多数人更长寿了。

lines.en: To keep fit, you have to walk at least 10,000 steps every day.
lines.zh: 为了保持健康，你每天至少要走一万步。

lines.en: We'd better get you to hospital.
lines.zh: 我们最好送你去医院。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Do you get the same amount of exercise today as in the past?
lines.zh: 你现在的锻炼量和过去一样多吗？

lines.en: Eating too much of the wrong food will harm your health.
lines.zh: 吃太多不健康的食物会损害健康。

lines.en: I thought we had an agreement to stay together.
lines.zh: 我以为我们说好了要待在一起。

lines.en: If you are worried about something, talk to your parents or teacher.
lines.zh: 如果你担心什么，告诉父母或老师。

lines.en: We'll catch up in a few minutes.
lines.zh: 我们几分钟后就赶上。

lines.en: Who's missing?
lines.zh: 谁不见了？

lines.en: Will I go blind?
lines.zh: 我会失明吗？

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: How do you feel?
lines.zh: 你感觉怎么样？

lines.en: Let's wait for the others.
lines.zh: 咱们等等其他人吧。

lines.en: Of course you will!
lines.zh: 你当然会没事的！

lines.en: Say no to smoking!
lines.zh: 对吸烟说不！

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Help yourself to some fish.
lines.zh: 随便吃点鱼吧。

lines.en: I was chosen to play the dance music.
lines.zh: 我被选去播放舞曲。

lines.en: It'll be held on the 30th of May.
lines.zh: 它将在5月30日举行。

lines.en: It's made with chicken and vegetables.
lines.zh: 它是用鸡肉和蔬菜做的。

lines.en: Knives and forks are used for most Western food.
lines.zh: 刀叉被用于大多数西餐。

lines.en: When is the school-leavers' party?
lines.zh: 毕业聚会是什么时候？

lines.en: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
lines.zh: 入乡随俗。

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: If you are offered more food but can't eat any more, say 'No, thanks.'
lines.zh: 如果再给你食物但你吃不下了，就说'不，谢谢'。

lines.en: It is polite to say you enjoy every dish.
lines.zh: 称赞每道菜是有礼貌的。

lines.en: That means you eat it with your fingers, not with a knife, fork or spoon.
lines.zh: 那意思是用手拿着吃，而不是用刀叉勺。

lines.en: The plates will be placed in the middle of the table.
lines.zh: 盘子会放在桌子中间。

lines.en: The teachers have asked everyone to prepare a traditional dish.
lines.zh: 老师要求每个人准备一道传统菜。

lines.en: We can heat it up in the school kitchen.
lines.zh: 我们可以在学校厨房把它加热。

lines.en: You should wait until you're invited to eat.
lines.zh: 你应该等到被邀请开动再吃。

title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Enjoy your meal!
lines.zh: 请慢用！

lines.en: I see what you mean.
lines.zh: 我明白你的意思了。

lines.en: It's becoming popular in China too!
lines.zh: 它在中国也越来越流行了！

lines.en: What about you, Tony?
lines.zh: 你呢，托尼？

unit: Module 7 English for you and me
title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: English is difficult to learn at the beginning.
lines.zh: 英语一开始学很难。

lines.en: English is spoken by about 400 million people.
lines.zh: 英语被大约4亿人使用。

lines.en: Have you ever been to an English corner?
lines.zh: 你去过英语角吗？

lines.en: How much progress do you think you've made in English this year?
lines.zh: 你认为你今年英语进步了多少？

lines.en: I think I've achieved a lot.
lines.zh: 我觉得我收获很大。

lines.en: If you keep trying, you can make progress quickly.
lines.zh: 如果坚持尝试，你就能很快进步。

lines.en: We all own English.
lines.zh: 我们都拥有英语。

unit: Module 7 English for you and me
title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Chinese will become as common as English by the middle of the twenty-first century.
lines.zh: 到21世纪中叶，汉语会变得和英语一样通用。

lines.en: English has borrowed many words from other languages.
lines.zh: 英语从其他语言借用了很多词汇。

lines.en: Even though we speak different types of English, we are all part of an international club.
lines.zh: 即使我们说不同类型的英语，我们都是国际俱乐部的一员。

lines.en: I hope I can continue to make progress next year.
lines.zh: 我希望明年能继续进步。

lines.en: It's also the subject that I'm best at.
lines.zh: 它也是我最擅长的科目。

lines.en: Some people think English requires too much effort to learn well.
lines.zh: 有些人认为学好英语要花太多精力。

lines.en: There is a good chance that you will meet someone who speaks English.
lines.zh: 你很有可能遇到说英语的人。

unit: Module 7 English for you and me
title: 重点句式跟读 3
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: At the same time, you can also help me with my Chinese.
lines.zh: 同时你也可以帮我学中文。

lines.en: I can see you really enjoy learning English.
lines.zh: 我能看出你真的喜欢学英语。

lines.en: I don't have to go to an English corner.
lines.zh: 我不必去英语角。

lines.en: It's also the subject that I'm best at.
lines.zh: 这也是我最擅长的科目。

title: 重点句式跟读 1
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Do you intend to stay in China for long?
lines.zh: 你打算在中国待很久吗？

lines.en: Even if I go back to the UK, I'll come back and visit you all.
lines.zh: 即使我回英国，我也会回来看大家。

lines.en: I'm very proud that you have chosen me to speak to you today.
lines.zh: 我很自豪你们选我今天来发言。

lines.en: I feel a bit sad. I don't know when we'll be back in this hall together again.
lines.zh: 我有点难过，不知道什么时候我们能再聚在这个大厅。

lines.en: Let's raise our glasses. Here's to our friendship, everyone... and to the future!
lines.zh: 咱们举杯。为我们的友谊，为未来干杯！

lines.en: You look lovely, Lingling!
lines.zh: 你看起来真漂亮，玲玲！

lines.en: You only really lose if you give up!
lines.zh: 只有放弃才是真正的失败！

title: 重点句式跟读 2
source: 外研版（2026新版）教材句式库

lines.en: Everyone needs a skill that is useful if they want a good life.
lines.zh: 如果想过好日子，每个人都需要一门有用的技能。

lines.en: I'm sure that you will be good at music. I know that you will be better at maths.
lines.zh: 我相信你会擅长音乐，我也知道你数学会更好。

lines.en: I've learnt to try my best, not only with running but with whatever else I do.
lines.zh: 我学会了尽全力，不仅是跑步，做任何事都如此。

lines.en: I want to become an English teacher!
lines.zh: 我想成为一名英语老师！

lines.en: There is no success without effort.
lines.zh: 没有努力就没有成功。

lines.en: They make the hall look wonderful.
lines.zh: 它们让大厅看起来棒极了。

lines.en: Workers who can make things and repair things will always be needed.
lines.zh: 会制造和修理东西的工人永远是被需要的。

lines.en: Cheers!
lines.zh: 干杯！

lines.en: Come on! Let's get something to eat.
lines.zh: 来吧！我们去弄点吃的。

lines.en: Good for you!
lines.zh: 你真棒！

lines.en: Thank you, friends, teachers and parents! We love you!
lines.zh: 谢谢朋友、老师和父母！我们爱你们！

lines.en: What's on the menu?
lines.zh: 菜单上有什么？
